_notes: Level 1 stats. max_distance = metres the ball travels in total (flight + roll) at 100% power on flat ground with no wind. launch_angle = degrees above the ground. roll_decel = how fast rolling slows the ball (m/s^2): bigger = stops sooner. sweet_spot = half-width of the green zone on the accuracy bar (0..1): bigger = more forgiving. backspin = 0..1, forward speed lost on the first landing. two_tap = power only, no accuracy tap (putter).
